title: Wrap SacredWindowEntries clear+insert in one transaction (DB-2)
why: The table is briefly empty between clearAll() completing and insertAll() starting; neither call is awaited by any caller and neither is wrapped in a transaction. invalidate()'s own separate unawaited clearAll() (line 50) can also interleave with _persistToDb()'s clear-then-insert pair (line 167) in either order. The class's own doc says this cache exists so 'background notification-fire-time checks can read them on cold-start without the Flutter engine' -- a background read landing in the empty gap, or after invalidate() wins a race against a slower insertAll(), sees no Sacred Time windows and could fail to suppress a notification during Shabbos/Yom Tov, the entire point of DNI-367. Confirming the full consequence requires reading the background notification-fire-time isolate handler, which is outside this batch.
recommendation: Wrap clear+insert in one db.transaction(...) and await it from both invalidate() and _persistToDb(), or add an explicit generation-counter guard so a stale clear can't stomp a newer insert.
acceptance_criteria: A DAO-level test that races invalidate() against a concurrent _persistToDb() cycle never observes SacredWindowEntries transition through an empty state once a non-empty write has committed.
